title: SET_TRUST_LINE_FLAGS fails with SET_TRUST_LINE_FLAGS_INVALID_STATE
pattern: A transaction whose SET_TRUST_LINE_FLAGS operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (invalid_state). Setting AUTHORIZED_TO_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES on an AUTHORIZED trustline without clearing AUTHORIZED would leave both set.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
